lines.text: Jesus went with His disciples across the Kidron Valley into a garden, where Judas knew He often met them.
Judas brought soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
Jesus stepped forward and asked whom they sought; when He said "I am He," they drew back and fell down.
They answered Jesus of Bethlehem again, and Jesus said to let His disciples go, fulfilling His word.
Peter struck the servant Malchus and cut off his left ear, and Jesus told him to put his sword away.
